#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp")
import gen2
from collections import Counter

def main():
    lo, hi = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2])
    cnt = Counter(); bad = 0; njobs = 0
    for seed in range(lo, hi):
        doc = gen2.gen(seed); payload = json.dumps(doc)
        a = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/submission/main.py"], input=payload.encode(),
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        b = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/tmp/ref.py"], input=payload.encode(),
                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        try: ja = json.loads(a.stdout)
        except Exception: print("seed", seed, "sub bad", a.stdout[:200], a.stderr[:300]); bad+=1; break
        try: jb = json.loads(b.stdout)
        except Exception: print("seed", seed, "ref bad", b.stdout[:200], b.stderr[:300]); bad+=1; break
        if "packets" not in ja:
            print("seed", seed, "sub INVALID but ref not:", "packets" in jb); bad+=1
            print(json.dumps(doc)[:300]); break
        if "packets" not in jb:
            print("seed", seed, "ref INVALID"); bad+=1; break
        for p in ja["packets"]: cnt[p["decision"]] += 1
        njobs += len(ja["jobs"])
        if ja != jb:
            bad += 1
            print("=== MISMATCH seed", seed)
            for k in ja:
                if ja[k] != jb[k]:
                    print(" field", k)
                    if k == "packets":
                        for x, y in zip(ja[k], jb[k]):
                            if x != y: print("  sub", x); print("  ref", y); break
                    elif k == "jobs":
                        for x, y in zip(ja[k], jb[k]):
                            if x != y: print("  sub", json.dumps(x)); print("  ref", json.dumps(y)); break
                    else:
                        print("  sub", json.dumps(ja[k])[:400]); print("  ref", json.dumps(jb[k])[:400])
            break
    print("gen2 seeds", hi-lo, "mismatches", bad, "jobs", njobs, dict(cnt))

main()
